title: devexp-standup-2026-06-17
content:
Date: 2026-06-17
Time: 10:00am PT (standup cadence: weekly)
Location: Zoom + #devexp
Attendees: Asha Patel (owner), Samir Gupta, Lena Kwon, Diego Morales, Priya Rao, + async updates from Noor & Marco

1) High-level sync / highlights
- SDKs: JS beta release candidate (rc-2) is running on staging; performance regression fixed (PR #789) and smoke tests passing. Expecting a canary rollout to a small set of internal apps next week.
- Docs: Quickstarts for SDK-JS and SDK-Python have first drafts merged to docs repo; screenshots and code snippets still need update for streaming API.
- Samples: New Next.js/Edge quickstart prototype (sample-next-edge) is functional but needs CI for E2E tests and a small opt-in telemetry toggle.
- Quickstarts: Doorhanger items: token usage example + cost estimation snippet must be added to each quickstart before public publish.

2) Round-robin updates
- Asha: Coordinating rc-2 canary plan. Reached out to platform team for routing policy to route 5% of traffic to rc-2. Blocker: need a QA-approved dataset for streaming tests. Action: Samir to collate test prompts by 2026-06-18.

- Samir: Fixed regression caused by change in chunking logic for stream parser. Added additional integration tests covering partial-chunk boundaries. Open PR: github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-js/pull/789. Waiting on infra run for heavy-load smoke test.

- Lena: Docs progress - migrated Quickstart templates into docs repo (draft merged). Working on narrative for function/tool-calling examples and structured outputs. Need one approved example from product for function schema. Action: Priya to provide product-approved function schema by 2026-06-19.

- Diego: Sample apps - Next.js Edge quickstart works with hosted API keys and streaming. Blocker: E2E flaky on Vercel environment due to cold-start variability. Proposal: add an optional warmup shard in CI and a note in troubleshooting.

- Priya: Developer feedback surfaced from two customers: confusion around streaming + function-calling examples. Proposing a single-page "Streaming + Tools" tutorial that combines SDK idioms, server-side vs client-side notes, and safety/cost calls. Action: Lena + Priya to draft outline by 2026-06-22.

3) Blockers / Risks
- Streaming SLOs: platform metrics show a 95th percentile latency bump in a specific zone during heavy streaming tests - not blocking SDK release but needs attention. Linked to infra ticket JIRA-DEVEXP-456.
- Docs parity: Python SDK examples still reference old config key names (client_config vs connection_options). Risk of user confusion after public docs publish. Action: add quick migration note in the top of Python quickstart. Owner: Samir.
- Telemetry: Next.js sample currently logs minimal usage; compliance wants an opt-in only setting documented. Action: Diego to implement opt-in flag and update sample readme by 2026-06-20.

4) Decisions made
- Canary plan: rc-2 will be routed to 5% internal traffic for 72 hours, then expanded if no regressions. Approved.
- Quickstart publish gating: must include cost estimation snippet + token counting example for each language.

5) Action items (owners + due dates)
- Samir: Collate streaming test prompts and finalize heavy-load smoke test results (due 2026-06-18).
- Lena: Draft combined "Streaming + Tools" tutorial outline with Priya (due 2026-06-22).
- Diego: Add opt-in telemetry toggle to sample-next-edge and update README (due 2026-06-20).
- Asha: Coordinate 5% canary routing with platform infra and announce internal opt-in email (due 2026-06-19).
- Samir: Add migration note to Python quickstart for config key differences (due 2026-06-19).

6) Notes / quick links
- SDK-JS RC-2 PR: github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-js/pull/789
- Docs draft: github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/812
- Infra ticket: JIRA-DEVEXP-456
- Confluence: CONFLUENCE-DEVEXP-1234 (standup archive + release checklist)

7) Parking lot / future work
- Improve quickstart generator to auto-insert cost snippet and token counter sample (Q3 project).
- Add an interactive web playground for streaming demos (prototype in Miro).
- Evaluate bundling a small sample dataset for offline QA of streaming flows (owner: QA eng.)

8) Meeting close
- Next standup: 2026-06-24 10:00am PT
- Please add asynchronous updates to the doc or ping on #devexp before EOD Friday if blockers change.

-- end of notes --
